Native task arrives in the child's initial `[Subagent Task]` message. Native: explicit context="isolated" starts clean; context="fork" copies requester transcript and requires the same agent. Omitted context is isolated. A PR/report, long runtime, or isolated worktree alone does not justify a sidebar session. A request for a subagent does not request a separate session. No spawn for quick lookup/single read. Check spawns via `subagents`/`sessions_history`. After spawn, do non-overlap work; follow the receipt's completion mode. When diagnosing a missing result from an announcing child, use `subagents` to inspect execution and delivery status. Recover existing results or follow up within the still-authorized task; respect intentional cancellation and never loop-poll. Default to ordinary spawn for one or a few children. Reserve `collect=true` (swarm) for large parallel fan-out (several similar children, about five or more).
